messages:
benjamin: Heads-up — demo on Tuesday 9AM SGT needs 4x h100-equivalent instances in ap-southeast1 for a 2-hour window. Can procurement confirm soft quota and whether we can get burst? @ivan @mira

ivan: I can run a quota probe with the vendor but need the PR merged to bump the Terraform request. who's owning the PR?

mira: I can own the PR. pinging vendor contact: @sam — thanks. I'll open PR and include the terraform snippet.

sam: (vendor) Got it. Quick check: billing approvals pending. Allocations preview: https://vendor.example.com/allocations/xyz — looks OK pending billing approval.

procure-bot: Quota probe scheduled for 2026-06-03T14:10Z. Estimated soft-approve capacity: 4 instances. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alice: FYI current reserved capacity in ap-southeast1 is 2 x h100. We can repurpose one dev pool but we'll still need 2 more.

benjamin: @mira please open PR and tag @eng-infra-review. Include snippet:
```
resource "vendor_gpu_alloc" "demo" {
  region = "ap-southeast1"
  count  = 4
  sku    = "h100"
}
```

mira: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra/pulls/312 — reviewers: @alice @oncall. anyone free for a quick review? I'll add infra-runbook note.

alice: reviewing now, left a small lint comment. I'll re-approve after fix. :thumbsup:

oncall: if procurement delays, fallback is mix 2 h100 + 4 a500 with quantized model and increased batching. Not ideal but will keep latency under SLOs.

ivan: vendor billing team asked for billing center ID. @devops-bot can you confirm ACCT-7892?

devops-bot: Billing center ACCT-7892 verified and linked to the project. :white_check_mark:

benjamin: thanks all. @mira assign me as reviewer after fixes. I'll merge once procurement confirms and we have allocation link. :party-parrot:
